name: Wizard Wand Savant
body:
A wand savant dedicates an immense amount of study in wands, their usage and creation.

Identify Wand (Ex)

At 1st level, the wand adept can identify the function and number of charges simply by holding a wand and examining it for 1 minute. No check or detect magic is needed. This ability replaces Scribe Scroll.

Wand Focus (Ex)

At 1st level, a wand savant can use their class level instead of the wand’s caster level and their own spell save DCs for the wand’s DC. This includes any feats or abilities that increase the CL or DCs of certain spells. Additionally, the wand savant gains a +1 attack bonus with any spell cast from a wand.

This ability replaces arcane bond.

Wand Quick Draw (Ex)

At 1st level, a wand savant can draw a single wand per round as a free action. Any additional wands drawn are swift actions. However, if the wand savant has a wand belt, all wand drawing and stowing are free actions. This ability replaces the arcane school ability at 1st level.

Siphon Wand (Su)

At 5th level, a wand savant can shift charges from one wand to another. As a standard action, they can shift the charges from one wand to another. However, some power is lost; it costs 2 charges per one charge shifted. Also, it takes additional charges if there is a difference in spell level. For example, it would require 6 1st-level wand charges to add 1 charge to a 3rd-level wand, or, 1 charge from a 2nd-level wand to add 1 charge to a 1st-level wand. This ability cannot increase a wand’s number of charges above 50. If a wand does not have sufficient charges, the transfer fails.

At 10th level, this transfer no longer requires 2 charges per charge added. Though the level difference still requires greater charges, or fewer, like a 2nd-level wand granting 2 charges to a 1st-level wand.

This ability cannot transfer uses per day from eternal wands to regular wands or visa versa, but they can do so between eternal wands.

This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 5th level.

Dual Wand Use (Su)

At 8th level, a wand adept can activate two wands simultaneously, assuming they are both held, as a single full-round action. Doing so is inefficient and consumes 1d4 charges from each wand. If this would consume more charges than the wand has available, it fails to activate. At 16th level, this no longer consumes more than 1 charge. This ability replaces the 8th-level arcane school ability.
